channel.title: Late Brake blog
channel.description: Formula 1 news, history, fun facts and what happened on this day.

item.title: On this day: Vettel's first title and Hamilton's Interlagos charge
item.description: On 14 November, Vettel became F1's youngest champion in Abu Dhabi in 2010, and Hamilton won from tenth at Interlagos in 2021 after a weekend of penalties.

item.title: FIA court to hear Audi's Tsunoda Monza appeal on 25 November
item.description: The FIA's International Court of Appeal will rule on Audi's challenge to Yuki Tsunoda's Italian Grand Prix point at a closed hearing in Paris.

item.title: Six F1 Austrian Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A 0.05-second finish, a deer on the track, a race that took three starts and a winner who gave away his trophy: six true stories from Spielberg.

item.title: Russell launches fully funded karting academy at Silverstone
item.description: George Russell's GR63 Karting Academy will pick 25 children aged eight and nine for a free eight-round championship at Silverstone in 2027.

item.title: On this day: Schumacher's Adelaide title, Hamilton's rain win
item.description: On 13 November, a collision decided the 1994 F1 title in Adelaide, Vettel's run ended in Abu Dhabi in 2011 and Hamilton won a soaked Interlagos race.

item.title: Racing Bulls keeps Lawson and Lindblad for 2027 F1 season
item.description: Liam Lawson has signed a new deal to stay at Racing Bulls with Arvid Lindblad, while F2 front-runner Nikola Tsolov becomes Red Bull's reserve.

item.title: How Silverstone hosted the first F1 World Championship race
item.description: A former RAF airfield, a King in the crowd and a clean sweep for Alfa Romeo: the story of the 1950 British Grand Prix, F1's first championship race.

item.title: Honda hunts cause of battery failures behind Stroll's F1 retirement
item.description: Honda says it must find the root cause of the battery problems that ended Lance Stroll's São Paulo Grand Prix, or risk the same issue next year.

item.title: On this day: Hill wins Adelaide by two laps, Vettel takes Interlagos
item.description: On 12 November, Damon Hill won the last Adelaide Grand Prix in 1995, Sebastian Vettel won at Interlagos in 2017 and George Russell won his first sprint.

item.title: Pirelli to bring new F1 wet and intermediate tyres for 2027
item.description: Pirelli will change its wet-weather F1 tyres for 2027 after drivers struggled to warm up the intermediates in the rain at Interlagos.

item.title: Six F1 Monza facts that sound made up, but are true
item.description: Five cars covered by 0.61 seconds, a boycott over the banking and McLaren's one defeat of 1988: six true stories from F1 at Monza.

item.title: FIA keeps F1 engine catch-up order unchanged in final 2026 review
item.description: The FIA's last ADUO review of 2026 left Red Bull Ford as the benchmark engine, with Ferrari, Honda and Audi still given the most upgrade chances.

item.title: On this day: de Filippis and Brambilla born, Hamilton wins in Brazil
item.description: On 11 November F1's first woman racer and the "Monza Gorilla" were born, and Hamilton's 2018 Interlagos win sealed a fifth Mercedes title.

item.title: F1 stands Imola down and keeps Qatar and Abu Dhabi finale
item.description: Formula 1 has told Imola it is no longer needed as a back-up, and will end the 2026 season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi as planned.

item.title: How Jordan won its first F1 race in the 1998 Spa chaos
item.description: A start-line pile-up, a blind collision in the spray and only eight finishers: how Damon Hill gave Jordan its first F1 win at Spa in 1998.

item.title: Verstappen leads five-way fight for second in F1 standings
item.description: With three F1 races left, Max Verstappen leads George Russell by 17 points and Lewis Hamilton by 18 in the battle to finish runner-up to Kimi Antonelli.

item.title: On this day: Lucien Bianchi, Eddie Irvine and Brendon Hartley born
item.description: Three F1 drivers born on 10 November: Monaco podium finisher Lucien Bianchi, 1999 runner-up Eddie Irvine and Le Mans winner Brendon Hartley.

item.title: Piastri ends management deal with Mark Webber after seven years
item.description: McLaren's Oscar Piastri and his managers Mark Webber and Ann Neal have agreed to end the partnership that began in 2019.

item.title: Six F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A race in a hotel car park, three champions crowned in fifth place and a loose cover that stopped practice: six true F1 stories from Las Vegas.

item.title: Leclerc penalised for Lawson clash after F1 São Paulo GP
item.description: Charles Leclerc dropped from seventh to eighth after a five-second penalty for hitting Liam Lawson, while Antonelli and Bearman were also punished.

item.title: On this day: Rosberg's Interlagos win and Norris's 2025 victory
item.description: Two F1 Brazilian races held on 9 November: Nico Rosberg's 2014 win that took the title to Abu Dhabi, and Lando Norris's dominant 2025 weekend.

item.title: Norris wins wet F1 São Paulo GP as Mercedes clinch the title
item.description: Lando Norris won a rain-hit F1 São Paulo Grand Prix ahead of Max Verstappen, while Mercedes sealed their ninth constructors' championship.

item.title: How Verstappen won from 17th in the 2024 Interlagos rain
item.description: Max Verstappen started the 2024 F1 São Paulo Grand Prix 17th in torrential rain and won by almost 20 seconds, all but settling his fourth title.

item.title: F1 extends Brazilian Grand Prix deal at Interlagos to 2035
item.description: Formula 1 has agreed a five-year extension with the São Paulo race, keeping the Brazilian Grand Prix at Interlagos until at least 2035.

item.title: On this day: Berger wins in Adelaide as Senna and Mansell collide
item.description: Lotus podium finisher Peter Arundell was born on 8 November 1933, and Gerhard Berger won a dramatic 1992 season finale in Adelaide.

item.title: Norris takes wet F1 São Paulo pole as Russell rues aborted lap
item.description: Lando Norris took pole for the F1 São Paulo Grand Prix in heavy rain at Interlagos, with grid penalties promoting Kimi Antonelli to second.

item.title: Six F1 Monaco Grand Prix facts that sound made up
item.description: A winner from 14th, a leader who swam out of the harbour and a race nobody wanted to win: six true stories from the F1 Monaco Grand Prix.

item.title: Russell to take five-place grid penalty at F1 São Paulo GP
item.description: George Russell will drop five places on the F1 São Paulo Grand Prix grid after Mercedes fitted his sixth internal combustion engine of 2026.

item.title: On this day: Senna's last win and Red Bull's first F1 title
item.description: Senna won for the last time in 1993, Red Bull took its first constructors' title at Interlagos in 2010 and Verstappen won in Mexico in 2021.

item.title: Antonelli tops F1 São Paulo practice after Norris leads FP1
item.description: New F1 champion Kimi Antonelli set the fastest lap of Friday at Interlagos, after McLaren's Lando Norris topped first practice.
